changelog:
- Initial release of the brainstorming skill for structured creative design.
- Enforces a strict process before any implementation: explore context, clarify requirements, propose approaches, and validate the design with user approval.
- Prevents skipping design on any project, regardless of perceived simplicity.
- Requires incremental user approval at each stage, with clear documentation expectations.
- Implementation action may only begin after a user-approved design and transition to the writing-plans skill.
